in_hebrew.name: Hebe
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Goddess of youth and prosperity
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hebe הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Hebe was the goddess of youth and the personification of the eternal youth of the gods. She was the cupbearer of the gods, ensuring their eternal youth and vitality by constantly refilling their cups with nectar and ambrosia.

in_greek.name: Ἥβη
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek goddess of youth, vitality, and the renewal of life.
